programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons

The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome.

programme.title: Life as It Should Be 2

Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People

Epsiodes highlight stories such as when Pen Farthing, a veteran of the war in Afghanistan, couldn't return with his companion dog and so he set up a shelter in Kabul that provides medical care for ex-servoice dogs; when animals need a prosthetic limb, Derrick Campana will desing one, even for an elephant; or when Animal Defenders International (ADI), try to introduce bans on circuses in Peru.

The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo: San Diego
programme.desc: "The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia

The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

Raised by him since cubs, Jeff's decision is not only emotionally charged but emotive in the message it gives of a 'father's' love to do the best for his young.

Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

The rare species' alleged extinction has been recently questions, due to recent photos appearing of unidentified sharks around Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Could the Pondicherry shark still be alive? If Galante can prove it's still alive, it will be removed off the extinct species list. Extinct or Alive.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Haunting In The Heartland
programme.desc: Something evil lurks in the shadows of the close-knit communities, idyllic Main Streets and rolling fields of America's heartland. Paranormal investigator Steve Shippy witnessed this darkness firsthand as a child growing up in rural Michigan. Now, with the help of local eyewitnesses and historical records, he's made it his mission to solve these mysterious hauntings and bring resolution to the living and the dead.

programme.title: The Holzer Files
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation.

Many places with shady past like hotels, casinos, homes, abandoned buildings are full of aggressive paranormal activities and do not let people live peacefully. Each episode begins with the crew touring the investigation site with its owners and interviewing the witnesses. Then the ghost hunters crew set up static night-vision cameras to film what's happening. They use a lot of up-to-date equipment to get any sort of evidence and then based on what they manage to get, they start analyzing and investigating things in order to get to the core of each case.

programme.title: Ghosts Of Morgan City
programme.desc: After a Louisiana city struggles to deal with the sheer volume of emergency calls relating to encounters with creepy ghosts, Police Chief James Blair hires a team of paranormal experts to ascertain the truth behind these ghoulish happenings. Morgan City's residents have been left feeling terrified and tense after reports that ghosts from the city's past have started to haunt the bayou area. Comprised of Louisiana local Jereme Leonard, psychic medium Sarah Lemos, former FBI agent Ben Hansen, and local historian Diane Wiltz, the team delves into the truth behind the ghostly events. Reality-documentary series.

programme.title: Building Alaska
programme.desc: Building Alaska is a reality and documentary TV series following a cast of characters who set out to construct three incredible cabins in the obscure Alaskan wilderness. There are no roads and no building supply centers around, and they have to deal with extreme weather conditions, not to mention curious animals. From the foundation to doors and windows, finishing with interior work and electrical system, everything should be done, so hours and hours of hard work are ahead of the participants.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable.

programme.title: True Crime with Aphrodite Jones
programme.desc: Crime documentary series hosted by Aphrodite Jones who looks into real-life crimes including some of the most atrocious murders of recent times. Jones shares details of these gruesome crimes alongside authentic footage, evidence and interviews with people associated to the case – sometimes even the perpetrator themselves. Subjects featured in the series include such high-profile cases as O. J. Simpson, Michael Jackson, the notorious Zodiac serial killer and the music producer Phil Spector. Jones attempts to get inside the minds of her subjects to better understand their motives for committing such unspeakable crimes. Aphrodite Jones is a true-crime expert, a former crime reporter for FOX News and the author of eight books.

programme.desc: Although the 1980s is one of the most fondly remembered decades, it was also a deadly one. This nostalgic crime documentary series looks beyond the big hair, bright and bold make-up, leg-warmers, electronic pop music, yuppie culture and classic movies. This series delves in the sinister side of the decade, revealing some of the more shocking events that took place at this time. Real-life murders are re-enacted. The series examines the incomprehensible outcomes of failing relationships, with emotionally charged partners taking the marital expression, till death do us part, far too literally.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: The Perfect Murder
programme.desc: This team of detectives are determined to detain the dangerous killers that they are faced with. What may initially seem like the "perfect murder" requires a great depth of investigation and dedication, but eventually the detectives crack them open and reveal the truth. The key to their success is their great level of persistence, and imaginative investigative skills. Dead ends won't deter the team, when a seemingly impossible case lands on their desks, they always find a way in the end.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: This series focuses on the dark underbelly of the American mid-west, its heartland. Each episode deals with a specific murder that's been commited in one of the small towns that make up this iconic region of the US with the locals enhancing the tales and bringing clues to our attention. The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

Alongside the team of world-class mechanics from his Gas Monkey Garage, Richard invests his precious time and money to get these toiling businesses back where they belong. The team visit workshops all over the USA, using their knowledge and experience to rev up the old girls and get their engines purring once more. With a serious amount of elbow grease on top of the help from Richard's team, the owners have a shot once more at a successful business.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Sweet Home Sextuplets
programme.desc: Courtney and Eric Waldrop, their three older boys and sextuplet babies are a tight-knit family living on a sheep farm in small town Alabama. Their strong desire for one more baby resulted in the biggest possible surprise- sextuplets. Have a close look at this adorable family and all of its members starting from the days when there were "just" five of them. Risky pregnancy, premature birth, arriving home, taking care of six babies, managing the whole family and adjusting to the new pace of life- all of this and much more are there for the viewers.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress With Gok
programme.desc: Fashion guru Gok Wan is at hand to ensure these excited brides look stunning in their dream wedding gowns. Teaming up with Ava Rose Hamilton and her party of consultants, Gok helps these young women choose a dress befitting the occasion, working with each bride individually to create marital masterpieces. Of course, the final decision lies with the bride, and they must say yes to the dress before they can flaunt it down the aisle.

programme.title: I Should Have Known
programme.desc: I SHOULD HAVE KNOWN follows the personal journeys of Lindsey and Francisco, two "Seekers" who discover late in life that they are not their parents' children. We meet our seekers as they process the shocking truth of their parentage. Over the course of the hour, we follow their search for answers through key emotional moments. Using a combination of documentary style footage and self-shot diary cameras, we watch as they as they uncover clues, hit dead-ends, and stumble upon breakthroughs, before finally reuniting with a newly discovered family member. Lindsey grew up believing she was the typical single child of divorced parents. Her Scottish mom was fair and tough, and her dad indulged her and showered her with love. Today, as a professional photographer, she credits her father for encouraging her artistic ambitions and for her natural talent. When her father died from lung cancer Lindsey was devastated. Then, her mom revealed a family secret that shook her identity to the core: Lindsey was donor conceived. The man she called her father was not her biological father. Overwhelmed with this life changing information, Lindsey is curious, confused, and searching for answers. Recently diagnosed with multiple sclerosis and expecting her second child, Lindsay wants to learn more about her genetic history. Her mother has not kept any records, and even if she had, the sperm donation process was completely anonymous. With nowhere to start, Lindsey must confront her mom and press her for details. It is the first time Lindsey has talked to her about her conception, and she hopes to find out why her parents lied to her. Using DNA genetic testing, and the help of genealogist Kathleen Brandt, Lindsay searches for her sperm donor by posting on DNA matching websites, and online forums for donor conceived children such as herself. Along the way, she learns she's part Jewish and part Italian, but little else about the identity of her donor. Then, unexpectedly through a match on a website, Lindsey finds her father, only to discover he does not want any contact with her. Luckily, Kathleen finds a sperm sibling, Justin, who is willing to meet. The two half-siblings meet in Boston, and Lindsey finds the brother she's always wanted. Francisco Ramirez grew up in Sacramento, California, raised by loving but much older parents. His brother was an adult when he was born, and his sister Fabiola was already 8. He knew his sister was adopted but he grew up always believing his parents were his biological parents. Only when Francisco's wife, Kellee, stumbled upon the truth at a family party, did Francisco discover he was adopted: and his entire family knew and conspired to keep it from him. Stunned and betrayed, Francisco cut off all ties with his adoptive family and sank into a depression that lasted for years. With the help of genealogist and private investigator, Susan Frei Williams, Francisco and Kellee discover his baptismal certificate in a Catholic church in Albuquerque, NM. The certificate has his biological mother's name on it, which turns out to be the missing clue Susan needs to track her down. Unfortunately for Francisco, he discovers both his mother and brother have died, but Susan finds his half-sisters who want to meet. In the touching reunion, Francisco gets the answers he seeks, and finds the peace that has eluded him ever since he found out the truth.

programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Divided By Design
programme.desc: Elevating design in a Brickell high-rise gets complicated by sloppy work, but clever use of space maximizes kitchen function. Also, Ray and Eilyn's condo needs an unexpected repair that diverts money from completing their forever home.

programme.title: The Blended Bunch
programme.desc: What started with tragedy, manifested into a once in a lifetime love story. Before meeting, Erica, a mother of 7, lost her husband to cancer and Spencer, a father of 4, lost his wife in a fatal car crash. Their worlds were completely shattered until they serendipitously met in an online widower support group. Finding love almost immediately, Erica and Spencer exchanged vows and were married after just 13 months. The series centers on their large, newly blended family that will face all kinds of challenges as they merge 11 children under one roof and adjust to a new life in Utah.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Bloody Tales of Europe
programme.desc: Gravediggers, witches and goat riders are the focus of BLOODY TALES - DARK ARTS where Tudor historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and journalist Joe Crowley venture into the unknown. Were the gravediggers of a town called Frankenstein guilty of spreading the plague with powders made from dead corpses? Why was a respectable surgeon accused of being a gang leader of devil worshipping thieves, and how did a small Basque village get caught up in the biggest witch hunt in Spanish history?

programme.title: Bloody Tales of Europe
programme.desc: From one of Rome's most feared Emperors to Hungary's Countess Dracula, BLOODY TALES reveals some of history's most infamous characters and events. In MONSTERS, Tudor historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and journalist Joe Crowley team up to investigate three extraordinary stories. Why did young Emperor Caligula with the Roman Empire at his feet rule through fear and madness? How did a decorated French war hero turn into a prolific child killer? And why did an aging Hungarian widow become known as Countess Dracula?

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: The UK's engineering wonders revealed: including innovative electric flying machines, ingenious skyscrapers, the secrets of London's Tower Bridge, a 57 billion pound railway and a mega-stadium with a surprising historical twist.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Explore the engineering wonders of Europe's northernmost region, from Iceland's epic lava-defying barriers to Finland's record-breaking vertical factory. This spectacular journey uncovers the Nordic's boldest builds including the construction of the world's largest wooden city and a Swedish ferry that doesn't just sail—it flies.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: This spectacular aerial trip reveals the Greek Islands as they have never been seen before. Flying cameras uncover the majestic beauty of the Santorini skyline, a summer festival with a fiery twist on the island of Spetses, and a visit to the island of Hydra where mules replace vehicles. We'll take a trip to an island with a uniquely Greek harvest, and fly over the fearsome defences of Corfu's Venetian fortress.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Lost Cities of the Bible
programme.desc: 6000 years ago, a people called the Sumerians built the worlds first cities in Southern Iraq, great metropolises like Uruk and Ur. The first westerners to explore these ruined cities were inspired by stories about them in the Bible but what was the world of Genesis really like? Our cameras have unprecedented access to new discoveries that reveal the extraordinary achievements of the Sumerian civilization and how its legacy influenced the later Biblical writers. At the ancient city of Girsu, archaeologists have unearthed the oldest bridge ever found in the world and a set of mysterious ruins that could transform how we see the rise of civilization. Why did southern Iraq play a key role in the Old Testament and did the collapse of the Sumerian world influence one of the greatest stories ever told Noah and the Great Flood? programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The story of Exodus is one of the great biblical tales, but why does ancient Egypt play such a central role? We follow a new season of excavations to find answers. Teams brush away layers of earth to reveal a magnificent lost palace and decipher reliefs from the temple of one of Egypt's greatest pharaohs. New discoveries shed light on the period in which this biblical story was set.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: Exodus and the conquest of the land of Canaan are among the Bible's most famous stories. They tell how the Israelites triumphed, with the help of the Ark of the Covenant. The problem is that there is little archaeological evidence that these tales happened exactly as the Bible describes. Across the Holy Land, archaeologists and investigators dig through the ruins of ancient cities to uncover the real world behind the biblical accounts. Just west of Jerusalem, one team explores a cave tomb to reveal evidence for the origins of the Israelites' enemies, the Philistines. In northern Israel, another team excavates the remains of the Canaanite kingdom's mightiest stronghold and finds mysterious Egyptian artifacts that shed new light on the traditional tale of the Israelites' journey to what the Bible calls the Promised Land.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In early-1900s Russia, Grigori Rasputin, the professed mystical healer, was both admired and disdained. Some believed he had the czar and czarina under a dark spell. The true Rasputin is hard to decipher, but his claims of prophetic powers led to a controversial and tragic role pivotal to Russian history. In China, a scholar found strange markings on ancient bones that unlocked age-old mysteries. The ancient Chinese believed these "oracle bone" markings could contain traces of the future. In Point Pleasant, West Virginia, a mysterious winged creature is sighted moments before a tragic bridge collapse. The creature, dubbed the "Mothman," sparked decades of debate. Is it real, and did it portend impending doom?

programme.title: Secret Bible
programme.desc: Tsunamis, earthquakes, war and disaster lurk around us. But are they the "End Days," as prophesied in the Bible? Is the Apocalypse really at hand? Some say yes - not only clergymen, but politicians, Biblical scholars, computer scientists, and businessmen. This episode explores the prophecies of the end of the world and compares them to newly uncovered scientific facts. Is "The Apocalypse" simply a First Century poetic description of an internal religious state, as some theologians insist, or is it a prophecy of impending doom that we must all face?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: Noah and the Great Flood is one of the Bible's best-known tales. Now, investigators seek to unravel the story's origins, which may predate the Old Testament. They explore some of the earliest cities in Mesopotamia, use the latest science to examine past climates, decipher clay tablets, and put an ancient blueprint of the Ark to the test. Immersive CGI brings this long-lost story to life.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The legend of David and Goliath is one of the Bible's most famous stories. It tells of a battle between a young shepherd boy and a nine-foot-tall warrior. Now, teams of archaeologists investigate the real world behind this epic showdown. At Tel Azekah, excavators uncover the remains of an ancient city, destroyed by a devastating fire. In Egypt, inscriptions from the Temple of Karnak hint at the surprising origins of the Philistines, some of the Bible's most fearsome warriors, and at the ruined city of Gath, excavators uncover a fragment of pottery with two ancient names. Did a real Goliath live in this city?

programme.title: Bloody Tales of Europe
programme.desc: Tudor Historian Dr. Suzannah Lipscomb and journalist Joe Crowley team up to investigate three of history's most mysterious MURDERS. How did legendary warrior-king Attila the Hun end up dead the morning after his wedding? Did Richard III really kill his own young nephews in the Tower of London? And who was behind the mafia-style hit that took out Juan Borgia - son of Rome's Godfather, Pope Alexander VI.

programme.title: Bloody Tales of Europe
programme.desc: What links a Scottish National hero, a Danish Viking Warrior and a Nazi SS Officer? All three experienced unusual and barbaric deaths by execution. In BLOODY TALES - EXECUTIONS, Tudor historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and journalist Joe Crowley team up to investigate three extraordinary stories. Did it take three attempts to execute Amon Goeth, the Nazi commander of a labour camp in World War 2; was the Viking Ragnar Lodbrok really killed by a pit full of snakes? And did William Wallace's punishment of death by hanging drawing and quartering, really fit the crime?

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In early-1900s Russia, Grigori Rasputin, the professed mystical healer, was both admired and disdained. Some believed he had the czar and czarina under a dark spell. The true Rasputin is hard to decipher, but his claims of prophetic powers led to a controversial and tragic role pivotal to Russian history. In China, a scholar found strange markings on ancient bones that unlocked age-old mysteries. The ancient Chinese believed these "oracle bone" markings could contain traces of the future. In Point Pleasant, West Virginia, a mysterious winged creature is sighted moments before a tragic bridge collapse. The creature, dubbed the "Mothman," sparked decades of debate. Is it real, and did it portend impending doom?

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G2. Real Madrid - Hapoel TA
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: II Maailmasõja suursündmused värvilisena
programme.desc: Kui Hitler tungib Poolasse, kuulutavad Suurbritannia ja Prantsusmaa välja sõja. 1940. aasta mais ründab Saksamaa peibutuseks Hollandit ja Belgiat. Wehrmacht ja Luftwaffe ründavad täie jõuga ning tundub, et Prantsusmaa on nurka mängitud.

programme.title: Natsid: Kurjuse niidid

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein pidi valimispropaganda jaoks oma sõnu väänama ja satub seetõttu skandaali, mis jõuab ajakirjandusse. Valimiskampaania on nüüd ohus ja Rein peab koos erakonna PR-Mehega asja siluma. Salakaval Urmas Viil on nüüd tõusnud Reinu asetäitjaks ja endised sõbrad, Eduard Kitzberg ja Hans-Kristjan on väga mures - Rein on avalikult nende vastu pööranud. Konstaabel Sile üritab aga omal käel Reinu vastu suurt mängu mängida ja satub keerulisse olukorda. Samal ajal pöörab aga Reinu kodune elu pea peale, kui Relika ema teda Relika rasedaks tegemises kahtlustama hakkab ja Reinu naisele anonüümkirja saadab.

Ferit teeb ka Sunaga koostööd. Kayal ei jää see märkamata. Kazim avaldab Seyranile mitmeid Korhanite saladusi ja palub tal Korhanitele kätte maksta. Seyran on kuuldust šokeeritud, kuid ta ei karda oma isa. Tal on hoopis teised kavatsused.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Matemaatikageenius Bobby loodab saada oma võrrandi klappima viktoriinifännist dr Rebeccaga ning Cindy ja Elan naasevad kuus aastat pärast oma esmakohtingut, et Fredi ja saatetiimiga head uudist jagada.

Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. programme.title: Karu Karla

Karla aitab väikestel põnnidel üle saada igasugustest hirmudest ja muredest, ning teeb seda parimal võimalikul viisil - killukese maagia ja kujutlusvõimega.

programme.title: Ella, Oscar ja Huu

programme.title: Hei, Kutsa!
programme.desc: Õppima ja ühiselt tegutsema innustav joonissari on mõeldud koolieelikutele ja selle peategelane on suur sõbralik Kutsa. Kutsa on Oravaklubi juht – see on selline isevärki koht, kus lapsed saavad koos igasuguseid vahvaid seiklusi ette võtta ja uusi asju avastada. Kutsa õpetab lastele üksmeelt, sihikindlust ja vaprust. Iga kord teenivad lapsed auhinnaks mõne uue märgi.

programme.title: Stella ja Sam
programme.desc: Sam tõuseb hommikul vasaku jalaga ja kõik läheb viltu. Stella aga teab rääkida õnne toovast kalliskivist. Sam tahab kohe minna seda otsima, aareteotsijatega liitub ka Feeliks. Lastel tuleb aga peale kõrbe rinda pista veel kurja sfinksi ja lõkse täis püramiidiga.

programme.title: Susapusa Okidos
programme.desc: Okido valmistub tähistama Pommumarjapiruka söömise päeva, aga Susapusa pistab ainukese marja nahka ja peab nüüd uut otsima minema. Pommumarjad on aga väga haruldased ja riknevad kiiresti. Miks toit rikneb ja kuidas seda kauem värskena säilitada, seda saame teada, kui läheme reisile koos Susapusaga.

programme.title: Luka lustisõidurong
programme.desc: Anna on liiga väike et paljusid asju teha, aga kui Lukal ja Mõmmikul tuleb sillatuge parandada, saab Annast ootamatu kangelane.

programme.title: Lammas Shaun
programme.desc: Nutikas lammas Shaun on täiesti püsimatu loom, kes kaasab pidevalt oma kaaslasi kõiksugu sekeldustesse, pöörates kodufarmis kõik pea peale.

programme.title: Vürtside võlumaailm
programme.desc: Rikkaliku loodusega Sri Lankalt on pärit Tseiloni kaneel, mille müügi monopoli eurooplased kord endale ihkasid. Tänapäeval toodetakse Sri Lankal kaneeli siiani väikestes istandustes ja käsitööna.

programme.title: Maahommiku lood
programme.desc: "Maahommik" toob ekraanile ärksad ideed, tegusad inimesed ja huvitavad ettevõtmised.

programme.title: Eurovisiooni laulud 2026
programme.desc: Austrias toimuva Eurovisiooni lauluvõistluse eel kuulavad korea ja Karl-Erik Taukar koos külalistega üle tänavused võistluspalad. Milliste riikide lood paitavad kõrva, kuidas kõlavad favoriitideks peetud esitused ja kes on ootamatu üllataja?

programme.title: Püramiidi tipus
programme.desc: Enamikku meie planeedist katavad mered ja ookeanid. Ometi on merebioloogia praegu umbes samas seisus kui olid maismaa-uurijad enne Charles Darwini avastusi, ütleb Eesti Mereinstituudi teadlane Jonne Kotta. Viimastel aastatel on tema huviobjektiks rannikumeri: kas selle elustik võimendab või pehmendab kliimamuutuste mõju? Kottal on koos Austraalia okeanograafidega käsil kolmeaastane projekt, milles eestlase roll on uurida meretaimede fotosünteetilist produktsiooni - palju mingi liik valgust ja toitaineid tarbib, palju hapnikku toodab ning kuidas kliimamuutus seda protsessi mõjutab. Käisime Austraalia idarannikul Coffs Harbouri linnas, kus Kotta teeb muuhulgas oma katseid. Saime teada, kuidas uurimustöö teisel pool maakera on seotud meie koduse Läänemerega. Saate autor Mihkel Kärmas, režissöör Tarvo Mölder, operaator Tauno Sirel, produtsent Ene-Maris Tali.

programme.title: Nolly
programme.desc: Sari käsitleb Briti seebistaari Noele Gordoni hiilgeaega ja järsku langust. Nimiosas on Helena Bonham Carter. Näitleja Noele Gordon aka Nolly mängib peaosa populaarses Briti seebiooperis "Crossroads", kuni stuudioboss otsustab tema lepingu lõpetada.

programme.title: Belle
programme.desc: Suzu on kõrvalises külas elav häbelik keskkooliõpilane, kes pole juba aastaid suutnud teda ümbritseva maailmaga suhestuda. Kui Suzu liitub ülipopulaarse massiivse virtuaalmaailmaga U, põgeneb ta muserdavast reaalsusest ja temast saab üle kogu maailma armastatud laulja Belle. "Belle'i" inspiratsiooniks on Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumonti 1756. aasta prantsuse muinasjutt "Kaunitar ja koletis" ja 1991. aasta Disney samanimeline animatsioon. Režissöör Mamoru Hosoda.

programme.title: Ukraina stuudio
programme.desc: President Donald Trump pidas pika telefonivestluse Kremli liidri Vladimir Putiniga, kes pakkus muu hulgas välja relvarahu 9. maiks. Kas selle taga on vaid hirm Ukraina droonide pärast, mis võivad rikkuda Moskva pidustused või vajavad venelased hingetõmbepausi ka rindel, seda analüüsib kindralmajor reservis Neeme Väli. Ukrainlased ongi droonisõja pidamisel olnud viimasel ajal silmapaistvalt edukad, aga mehitamata õhusõidukite arendamisega on loomulikult edasi liikunud ka venelased. Selle valdkonna arenguid valgustab vabatahtlik Ukraina abistaja Raivo Olev MTÜ-st Võidutahe. Saatejuht on Reimo Sildvee. Toimetaja Peep Kala, režissöör Rait Roland Veskemaa, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Spektaakel
programme.desc: Igal aastal kogunevad tuhanded Eesti venekeelsed elanikud Narva jõe äärde seda kontserti jälgima. Kontsert ülistab Nõukogude minevikku ja püüab emotsionaalselt siduda kohalikku venekeelset kogukonda Venemaaga. Dokumentaal uurib süvitsi Ivangorodis toimunud Eesti publikule suunatud kõnekontserti, mis paraku polnud sugugi neutraalne mälestusüritus - tegemist oli hoolikalt lavastatud vaenuliku psühholoogilise operatsiooniga. "Spektaakel" paljastab, kuidas 9. mai Ivangorodi kontserdi kaudu viib vaenulik Venemaa läbi sihitud provokatiivset rünnakut Eesti vastu. Ekspertide, sealhulgas Valgevenest põgenenud endiste jõustruktuuride operatiivtöötajate abil lammutame selle jabura, pompöösselt lavastatud nostalgiatralli tükkideks, paljastamaks Kremli pahatahtlikke mõjutusmeetodeid ja neid pahatahtlikke inimesi, kes seda "projekti" Venemaa poolelt korraldavad. Režissöör Ken Saan. Tootja Svetlana Filmid.

programme.title: Tugitooliteater
programme.desc: Juhan Peegli jutustuse "Vanaisa" instseneering. Osades Ants Ander ja Imre Pung. Režissöör Ants Müürsep, toimetaja Lehte Ander. Täna on Ants Anderi 95. sünniaastapäev.

Suurbritannia linnades filmitud sarjas näeme päris patsiente kriisiolukorras ja meie arstid Chris ning Xand näitavad, kui põnevalt toimib kiirabi ja milleks on meie keha suuteline äärmuslikes olukordades.

programme.desc: Hopsi ema leiab aasalt ristikheinalehe, mis peaks õnne tooma. Paraku kaotab Hops lehe ära ja tal hakkab kohe viltu vedama! Kas ristikheinaleht saab tõesti õnne ja ebaõnne tuua?

programme.title: Lammas Shaun
programme.desc: Nutikas lammas Shaun on täiesti püsimatu loom, kes kaasab pidevalt oma kaaslasi kõiksugu sekeldustesse, pöörates kodufarmis kõik pea peale.

programme.title: Luise ja Oliver
programme.desc: Luise ja Oliver on õde ning vend, kes elavad oma tavalist õe ja venna elu. Mängivad põnevaid mänge, õpivad uusi teadmisi ja tunnevad huvi, kuidas maailmas asjad käivad. Ja isegi kui mõni teema neid vaidlema paneb, leitakse sõbralikult koos lahendus igale küsimusele. Näitlejad Maarja Johanna Mägi ja Aaron Thor Härm, režissöör Kristo Veinberg, stsenarist Robert Kõrvits, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Suuruurijad
programme.desc: Täna peavad Suuruurijad üles leidma direktor McGillicki kadunud tassi ja Ezra õe kadunud kübara!

programme.title: Eurovisiooni laulud 2026
programme.desc: Austrias toimuva Eurovisiooni lauluvõistluse eel kuulavad korea ja Karl-Erik Taukar koos külalistega üle tänavused võistluspalad. Milliste riikide lood paitavad kõrva, kuidas kõlavad favoriitideks peetud esitused ja kes on ootamatu üllataja?

programme.title: Kultuuriuudised
programme.desc: Ülevaade kultuurielus toimuvast.

programme.title: Püramiidi tipus
programme.desc: Enamikku meie planeedist katavad mered ja ookeanid. Ometi on merebioloogia praegu umbes samas seisus kui olid maismaa-uurijad enne Charles Darwini avastusi, ütleb Eesti Mereinstituudi teadlane Jonne Kotta. Viimastel aastatel on tema huviobjektiks rannikumeri: kas selle elustik võimendab või pehmendab kliimamuutuste mõju? Kottal on koos Austraalia okeanograafidega käsil kolmeaastane projekt, milles eestlase roll on uurida meretaimede fotosünteetilist produktsiooni - palju mingi liik valgust ja toitaineid tarbib, palju hapnikku toodab ning kuidas kliimamuutus seda protsessi mõjutab. Käisime Austraalia idarannikul Coffs Harbouri linnas, kus Kotta teeb muuhulgas oma katseid. Saime teada, kuidas uurimustöö teisel pool maakera on seotud meie koduse Läänemerega. Saate autor Mihkel Kärmas, režissöör Tarvo Mölder, operaator Tauno Sirel, produtsent Ene-Maris Tali.

programme.title: Aasta planeedil Maa
programme.desc: Doksarja filmiti üle kolme aasta enam kui 60 võttepaigas üle kogu maailma. Nii suur ettevõtmine oleks olnud võimatu ilma teadlaste, looduskaitsjate ja kohalike elanike abita. Nad näitavad meile loomi täiesti uuest küljest, on võtnud appi uuenduslikud ja leidlikud meetodid ning riskivad loomade nimel isegi oma eluga.

programme.title: Aktuaalne kaamera. Ilm
programme.desc: "Aktuaalne kaamera" on Eesti Televisiooni igapäevane eestikeelne uudistesaade.

programme.title: Päeva püük
programme.desc: Saatesari teeb kokkuvõtte kultuuris toimuvast - kogub kokku kultuurikillud ja -uudised, mida ERR-i lainetel on märgatud. Saadet teevad Aaron Thor Härm, Martin Kosseson, Kadi Priske, Coco Rõõmusaar, Mattias Lunge, Kert Pallo.

programme.title: Dokfilm Kodu on koht, kus ma kunagi olnud ei ole
programme.desc: Iana kasvas üles Vladivostokis, kaugel Eestist, kuid tema perekonnaloos oli oluline side selle maaga: tema eestlasest vanavanaema rääkis talle lapsepõlves oma kodusaarest Saaremaast. Need lood jätsid Iana mällu sügava jälje ning istutasid temasse igatsuse paiga järele, mida ta polnud kunagi näinud, kuid mis tundus ometi tuttav. Aastaid hiljem kannab Iana endas endiselt soovi ja sisemist vajadust see paik üles otsida — nii vanavanaema mälestuse kui ka iseenda jaoks. Road-movie vorm võimaldab vaatajal olla Iana kõrval kogu selle rännaku vältel. R: Masha Bakhtina. Tootja Davai Laama.

programme.title: Cannes. Lõikamata
programme.desc: 1946. aastal alustanud Cannesi filmifestival on kehtestanud end maailma juhtiva filmipeona, kuhu meelelahutusmaailma säravaimad superstaarid igal aastal kokku tulevad, et ennast näidata ja oma töid tutvustada. Sellest on saanud ka tähtis filmiturg ja moeüritus. Oma kogemusi seoses Cannesiga jagavad korraldajad, žüriiliikmed, näitlejad ja ajakirjanikud.

programme.title: Edmond
programme.desc: Lugu sellest, kuidas noor kirjanik Edmond Rostand paneb paberile näidendi "Cyrano de Bergerac". Selleks tuleb loomingulises kriisis vaevleval kahe lapse isal maadelda naise armukadeduse, näitlejate ja produtsentide kapriiside ning ümbritsevate inimeste ükskõiksusega. R: Alexis Michalik. O: Thomas Solivérès, Olivier Gourmet, Mathilde Seigner.

programme.title: Päeva püük
programme.desc: Saatesari teeb kokkuvõtte kultuuris toimuvast - kogub kokku kultuurikillud ja -uudised, mida ERR-i lainetel on märgatud. Saadet teevad Aaron Thor Härm, Martin Kosseson, Kadi Priske, Coco Rõõmusaar, Mattias Lunge, Kert Pallo.

programme.title: Sina ja mina
programme.desc: Beni ja Jessi tabab armastus esimesest pilgust. Järgneb kiire kokkukolimine, õnnelik lapseootus ja peadpööritav romantika. Siis aga juhtub kohutav tragöödia, mis pöörab kõik pea peale.

programme.title: Tulejoonel
programme.desc: Päeval, mil tapeti president Kennedy, oli Frank Horrigan üks tema ihukaitsjatest. Ebaõnnestunud missioon ei anna talle siiani rahu. 30 aastat hiljem saab temast endast märklaud.

programme.title: Gootika
programme.desc: Halle Berry mängib psühhiaatrit. Teda süüdistatakse mõrvas, mida ta ei mäleta. Filmis tegid kaasa ka Penelope Cruz ja Robert Downey Jr.

programme.title: Musketär
programme.desc: Alexandre Dumas' romaani on täiendatud idamaisete nootidega. D'Artagnan unistab liitumisest kuninga elitaarsete ihukaitsjate musketäridega ja leida mees, kes tappis tema vanemad.

programme.title: Uus tütar
programme.desc: Üksikisa kolib oma kahe lapsega Lõuna-Carolina maakohta. Seal märkab ta, et tema tütar hakkab aina kummalisemalt käituma.

programme.title: Kõuepäevad
programme.desc: Noor ja hulljulge võidusõiduauto piloot saab võimaluse osaleda tippvõistlusel.

programme.title: Äikese heli
programme.desc: 2055. aastal on ajas rändamine tõeks saanud. Igaüks saab nüüd dinosaurustele külla minna, kuid üks ettevaatamatu samm minevikus muudab täielikult tulevikku...

programme.title: Langus
programme.desc: Mägironimismatkal juhtub õnnetus ning parimad sõbrannad Becky ja Hunter jäävad lõksu 600 meetri kõrguse teletorni tippu.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Aeon Flux on salapärane palgamõrvar, kes töötab valitsust kukutada plaanivate mässajate heaks. Ta saadetakse mõrvama valitsusjuhti ja sellest hakkavad lahti hargnema räpased saladused.

programme.title: Metsik jõgi
programme.desc: Gail on perega parvematkal, et tähistada poja sünnipäeva, aga ootamatu kokkupõrge muudab pereürituse õudusunenäoks...

programme.title: Unustatud
programme.desc: Leinava ema elu muutub väga tormiliseks, kui ta kuuleb, et ta surnud poeg oli kõigest tema ettekujutuse vili. Peaosas Julianne Moore.

programme.title: Liblikas
programme.desc: Üksildane liblikaid koguv leskmees leiab oma autost ühe naabri üheksa-aastase tütre

programme.title: Pildid teispoolsusest
programme.desc: Pärast traagilist õnnetust avastab noorpaar pilte ilmutades, et kõigile nende fotodele ilmuvad hirmutavad, kummituslikud kujud.

programme.title: Nagu ülal, nõnda all
programme.desc: Pariisi all peitub kilomeetrite kaupa käänulisi ning kitsaid katakombe, mis on igaveseks koduks lugematutele hingedele. Kui tiim noori seiklejaid ja arheolooge otsustab siseneda kaardistamata luu-labürinti, paljastatakse saladus, mida see surnute linn pidi endas varjama.

programme.title: Linn mere ääres
programme.desc: R: Michael Caton-Jones. O: Robert De Niro, James Franco. Psühholoogiline põnevik New Yorgi politseiuurijast ja tema uimastisõltuvusse langenud pojast, keda süüdistatakse mitme toimepandud mõrva eest. Eluga pahuksisse sattunud Joey (James Franco) satub järjekordsel uimastirallil narkokaubitseja tapmise tunnistajaks ja peab ennast varjama. Mõrvu asub uurima noormehe isa, tunnustatud seadusesilm Vincent (Robert De Niro), keda vaevavad pojaga juhtunu tõttu mineviku deemonid. Ta mõistab, et ainukene võimalus Joeyt kindlast surmast päästa, on ta üles leida ja temalt andestust paluda.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: Mehhikos tähendab "sicario" palgamõrvarit.USA ja Mehhiko vahel paiknevas seadusetus piiritsoonis palkab valitsuse operatiivgrupi ametnik hoogu koguvasse narkosõtta appi idealistliku FBI agendi.Meeskond, mida juhib kahtlase minevikuga mõistatuslik konsultant, läheb ülisalajasele teekonnale, mille käigus peab Kate ellujäämise nimel kahtluse alla seadma kõik oma senised tõekspidamised. Filmi "Vangistatud" režissööri Denis Villeneuve'i uus film, mille peaosas on Emily Blunt, Benicio del Toro ja Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Ehast koiduni
programme.desc: Kultuslik õudusmärul! Seth (George Clooney) ja Richard (Quentin Tarantino) Gecko on kaks kurjategijatest venda, kes on Texase suurimad tagaotsitavad. Neil on vaja kohtuda Mehhikos Carlosega, kes hea summa eest pakuks neile varjupaika, seega võtavad nad pantvangi Fullerite perekonna, et nood aitaksid neid üle piiri. Mehhikos peatuvad nad stripibaaris Titty Twister, kuhu Carlos pidi hommikul saabuma. Selgub, et enamik baarisviibijatest on vampiirid ning saabub öö, mis näib põrgulikult pikk. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Valitse minu üle
programme.desc: Draama edukast hambaarstist dr Alan Johnsonist, kes kohtub üle pika aja taas oma kunagise kolledži toakaaslase Charlie Finemaniga, kes kaotas kogu oma perekonna 11. septembri terroriaktis. Charlie on maailmast ja inimestest täielikult eraldunud ning ei taha kellegagi suhelda. Alan püüab teda aidata, aga üksindusse jäänud Charlie ei suuda ega taha mitte kellegi abi vastu võtta. Nüüd on Charile aga leidnud oma vana sõbra ja see asjaolu võibki olla võti leinast ülesaamiseks.

programme.title: Süütud enesetapud
programme.desc: Vaikne ja konservatiivne Ameerika linn 1970ndatel. Lisbonid on tavaline keskklassi perekond - matemaatikaõpetajast isa, kodune usklik ema ja nende viis teismelist pilkupüüdvat tütart. Perekonna elu võtab aga uue suuna, kui noorim, 13-aastane Cecilia, ootamatult enesetapu sooritab. Peale traagilist sündmust isoleerib pere ülejäänud tütred ühiskonnast, ent vastasmajas elavad tüdrukute eakaaslastest vennad kavandavad tüdrukute päästmist.

programme.title: A.I. - tehisintellekt
programme.desc: Inimkond on loonud robotid, kes suudavad tunda tundeid, kuid ei ole võtnud vaevaks õpetada neid oma emotsioonidega toime tulema. Laps-robot püüab oma niinimetatud ema armastust tagasi võita.

programme.title: Väike merineitsi
programme.desc: Kuri nõid kasutab ära näkineiu naiivsust ja röövib ta hinge. Päästa võiks neiu vaid tõeline armastus, mida ta kohtab noore muinasjutuvestja näol.

programme.title: Vabaliikumises
programme.desc: Suurlinnas elav teismeline Ren MacCormac kolib väikelinna, kus on keelustatud rockmuusika ja tantsimine. Nooruki mässumeelne vastuhakk raputab kohalikke.

programme.title: Liblikmehe ettekuulutus
programme.desc: Kaks aastat pärast oma naise traagilist surma satub ajakirjanik ameerika väikelinna, kus toimuvad seletamatud sündmused.

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Ära iial ütle iial
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm jälgib Justin Bieberit ja näitab kaadreid tema esinemistelt 2010. aasta turneel.

programme.title: Näljamängud: Pilapasknäär - Osa 2
programme.desc: Ulmesaaga Katniss Everdeeni võitlusest Kapitooliumi diktatuuri ja president Snow vastu jõuab dünaamilisse ja pingelisse finaali.

programme.title: Liblikmehe ettekuulutus
programme.desc: Kaks aastat pärast oma naise traagilist surma satub ajakirjanik ameerika väikelinna, kus toimuvad seletamatud sündmused.

programme.title: A.I. - tehisintellekt
programme.desc: Inimkond on loonud robotid, kes suudavad tunda tundeid, kuid ei ole võtnud vaevaks õpetada neid oma emotsioonidega toime tulema. Laps-robot püüab oma niinimetatud ema armastust tagasi võita.

programme.title: Igavene armastus
programme.desc: Pärast nende kahe lapse surma üritavad Chris Nielson (Robin Williams) ja tema naine Annie (Annabella Sciorra) oma eluga küll edasi minna, kuid leiavad, et see ei ole sugugi kerge.

programme.title: Chloe
programme.desc: Põnevusdraama kahtluste küüsis vaevlevast naisest, kes üritab tõestada abikaasa truudusetust ja palkab eskorttüdruku meest võrgutama, pannes sellega tahtmatult ohtu terve oma pere. Cathrine on lugupeetud arst ja tema abikaasa David pühendunud muusikaprofessor. Hommikul pärast seda, kui David on maha jäänud kojulennust ning ilma Catherine'i uhkest sünnipäeva üllatuspeost, hakkab naine teist kahtlustama. Catherine satub kokku Chloe-nimelise eskorttüdrukuga, palkabki ta piltilusa blondi kaunitari abikaasa truudust testima. Mida kaugemale katse läheb, seda kahtlasemaks muutuvad Chloe'i enda motiivid ja abielunaist haarab hirm, et olukord on kontrolli alt väljunud...

programme.title: Pornokuninga piinad
programme.desc: Rež: Miloš Forman, os: Woody Harrelson, Courtney Love, Edward Norton. Kahe Kuldgloobusega pärjatud eluloodraama pornoajakirja "Hustler" asutajast Larry Flynt'ist (Woody Harrelson), kellest sai tuntud sõnavabaduse eest võitleja. Film jälgib kaasahaaravalt miljoneid teeniva erootikaimpeeriumi rajaja kirevat eraelu, mis oli täis seksikaid naisi ja pööraseid pidusid, millest igaüks tahtis osa saada. Teisalt oli Flynt'i elu ka kõike muud kui meelakkumine. Olles aheldatud tapmiskatse tagajärjel 1978. aastal ratastooli, jätkas mees võitlust nii usu kui ka sõna- ja trükivabaduse nimel. Manalateele läinud legendaarse režissööri Miloš Formani ("Amadeus") linateos pälvis Berliini filmifestivalil peapreemia. Peaosalist kehastanud Woody Harrelson ("True Detective") kandideeris rolliga meespeaosalise Oscarile.

programme.title: Kustutatud poiss
programme.desc: Baptisti jutlustaja poeg osaleb vastu tahtmist kiriku toetatud geide pööramise programmis pärast seda, kui vanemad ta vägisi kapist välja sundisid.

programme.title: Brokenwoodi mõrvad
programme.desc: Jõuluvana kostüümis mees leitakse tee äärest surnult. Kui Gina teatab, et surma põhjuseks oli elektrilöögist tekkinud infarkt, kahtlustatakse roima.

programme.title: Tormi silmas
programme.desc: Suur katastroofi-põnevusmärul enneolematust tornaadost, mis paiskab lennukid taevast alla ja muudab linna hetkega rusudeks. Samal ajal kui enamik inimesi püüab oma elu päästa ja otsib meeleheitlikult varju, otsustab grupp "tormipüüdjaid" tungida otse tornaado südamesse... Vapustavate eriefektidega hittfilm toob ekraanile looduse kõige äärmuslikuma külje.

programme.title: Reporter+
programme.desc: Uudistemagasinide lipulaev, mis toob olulisemad ja põnevamad uudised kodumaalt ja mujalt maailmast vaatajateni Reporterile omasel mahlakal moel. Saatejuhid on alati soliidsed Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap.

programme.title: Telehommik
programme.desc: "Tere hommikust, Telehommik alustab," tervitavad vaatajaid igal argipäeva hommikul saatejuhid Romi Hasa ja Kristjan Gold Kanal 2 otsestuudiost. "Telehommik" alustab päeva värskete uudiste, sisukate vestluste ja mõnusa meelelahutusega. Hommiku jooksul jõuavad ekraanile põnevad külalised ja lood Eestimaa eri paigust ning jagatakse praktilisi nõuandeid. See on hommik täis head tuju ja vajalikku infot, millega pikale päevale vastu minna.

programme.title: Silmast silma
programme.desc: Avameelne intervjuusaade, kus Eesti elu keskmes olev inimene seisab silmitsi julgete ja otsekoheste küsimustega. Saate külaline on tänavuse Koosmeele auhinna vastne võitja Eero Janson, küsimusi esitab Neeme Raud.

programme.title: Telehommik
programme.desc: "Tere hommikust, Telehommik alustab," tervitavad vaatajaid igal argipäeva hommikul saatejuhid Romi Hasa ja Kristjan Gold Kanal 2 otsestuudiost. "Telehommik" alustab päeva värskete uudiste, sisukate vestluste ja mõnusa meelelahutusega. Hommiku jooksul jõuavad ekraanile põnevad külalised ja lood Eestimaa eri paigust ning jagatakse praktilisi nõuandeid. See on hommik täis head tuju ja vajalikku infot, millega pikale päevale vastu minna.

programme.title: Öökülaline
programme.desc: Sandra Sillamaa on Eesti populaarseim moodne rahvamuusik, kes on vallutanud nii Eesti kui ka välismaa lavad ja teinud oma isiklikest läbielamistest elu motod ja kaasaegse kogemusnõustamise. Sandra teab, mida tähendab seista elu suurte valikute ees ning kuidas leida selgusehetki keset ärevust ja kõhklusi. Öökülalise saates laseb ta vaatajal piiluda oma sisemaailma ja teekonda, mis on toonud teda nii muusika kui eneseotsingute kaudu uute algusteni. Tema lugu julgustab nägema, et igas inimeses on peidus rohkem võimalusi, kui ta alguses oskab aimata. Saatejuht: Mart Normet, toimetajad Sigrid Salutee ja Kairit Tsäro-Mirme, rezhissöör Andreas Lenk, operaator Aivo Rannik, helioperaator Marko Sein.

programme.title: Meie aasta Austraalias
programme.desc: Tuuli hoiatab lapsi laine eest, mis viib endaga kaasa, satub aga ise RIP lainesse. Samuti hoiatab tapvate meduuside eest, ent saab ise pudelmeduusilt kõrvetada. Lastele ulatab ookean aga terekäe - nad saavad sõbraks kahe vee-asukaga: ühe surfiõpetaja Zeroga ja ühe muhk-hiidhuul kala Mollyga.

programme.title: Küladetektiivid
programme.desc: Iga-argipäevane kogupere detektiivisari kahest vastandlikust kriminaalpolitseinikust, kes uurivad maalilises baieri väikeasulas Rosenheimis põnevaid kuritegusid. Kõhukas komissar Korbinian elab õega talus ja lahendaks meeleldi kuritegusid otse traktoriroolist mobiiltelefoni teel - see on ainus tehniline vidin, mida ta on valmis tunnistama. Temast poole noorem, suurlinnast Rosenheimi tulnud komissar Ulrich on aga hea väljanägemisega, armastab kiireid autosid ja on tõeline arvutifriik.

programme.title: Mägipäästjad
programme.desc: Mootorsaan kaotab juhitavuse ja ähvardab kuristikku kukkuda. Markusel õnnestub juht edukalt päästa. Selgub, et tegu on endise vangi Freddyga, kes põhjustas surmaga lõppenud liiklusõnnetuse. Alexile ei meeldi tõsiasi, et Nina kuulub taas mägipäästjate tiimi. Tobi ja Katharina tülitsevad hotelli pärast.

programme.title: Proua Fazilet ja tema tütred
programme.desc: Rünnak Ece vastu tekitab häärberi elanikes tõelise šoki. Kui Hazim ja Fazilet Ecele appi tormavad, selgub, et Selin ei saa enam häärberisse jääda. Uks, mis talle avaneb, määrab tema saatuse. Kerime lubab Hazanil enda juurde jääda. Sinan otsib võimalust Hazaniga rääkida. Fazilet solvub sügavalt, kui Ece lepingule alla kirjutab.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Ella kurvastab, et Georgi ja Isa suhted on endiselt sassis, kuigi Georg ei anna alla ja aina püüab ning püüab Isaga rääkida. Linda suudleb Chrisi ja meest valdab tunnetekaos. Proua Kleinil hakkab halvem ja Chris ning Ella jooksevad ajaga võidu, et naist päästa. Lukas kutsub Becky neile elama.

programme.title: Naabriplika
programme.desc: Vallavanema naine on lõpuks ometi oma luulekogu välja andnud, mis vallandab ka kiriklas suurema kirjutamispuhangu. Paavel aga teeb midagi sellist, mis Krista kopsu üle maksa ajab ning ta kodust lahkuma sunnib. Loomulikult ei tee vallavanem seda meelega. Ta on ju tegelikult hea ja südamlik inimene. Üheskoos Kröösmaniga hakkab vallavanem otsima lahendusi Krista lepitamiseks, kuid selleks kulub kahjuks palju joodavat. Seda enam, et ka Kröösman ise on kodust taaskord välja visatud. Tola mõistab valesti Aliina möödaminnes poetatud vihjet ja asub koos Sookratese ning Inseneriga oma armastust päästma. Varik aga kohtub silmast silma Aliinaga ja talle meenuvad vanad head ajad, kui ta veel Violettaga plaane pidas. Ühesõnaga - Esna mees kukub auku. Aga lõpeb seekord kõik vaatamata jõupingutustele siiski isegi nagu kenasti. Vähemalt kõige hullem jääb seekord juhtumata.

programme.title: Reporter
programme.desc: Uudistemagasinide lipulaev, mis toob olulisemad ja põnevamad uudised kodumaalt ja mujalt maailmast vaatajateni Reporterile omasel mahlakal moel. Saatejuhid on alati soliidsed Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap.

programme.title: 15 küsimust
programme.desc: Kodumaine strateegiline mälumäng, mille muudab kaasahaaravaks põnev vihjete süsteem ja strateegia element. Saates on vastamisi kaks mängijat, kel on võimalus hakata panustama enda tugevustele ning samal ajal vastase nõrkusele. Mõnikord võib selline tegutsemine edu tuua, aga teinekord hoopis kätte maksta ning vajalikest punktidest ilma jätta. Saadet juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Kuuuurija
programme.desc: Katrin Lust läheb Eesti inimeste juurde, sinna, kus mured päriselt algavad. Ta annab hääle neile, keda pole kuulatud ja toob lihtsa eesti inimese lood avalikkuse ette üle kogu Eesti. Saade uurib ka keerulisi ja tundlikke teemasid ning seisab nende inimeste eest, kes on oma murega jäänud üksi.

programme.title: Silmast silma
programme.desc: Avameelne intervjuusaade, kus Eesti elu keskmes olevad inimesed seisavad silmitsi julgete ja otsekoheste küsimustega. Saatejuhid Neeme Raud ja Elo Mõttus-Leppik istuvad päevakangelastega silmast silma ning räägivad päris inimeste päriselt olulistel teemadel.

programme.title: Õhtu!
programme.desc: Armastatud saatejuhid Piret Laos, Robert Rool ja Jüri Butšakov saadavad vaatajaid argiõhtus rõõmsameelse ja positiivse vestlussaatega. Stuudios arutatakse kõikvõimalikel teemadel ning ka tõsisemad jutud saavad aetud heas ja toetavas õhkkonnas. "ÕHTU!" paneb tööpäevale mõnusa punkti ja loob hea tuju.

programme.title: Heeringas Veenuse õlal
programme.desc: Vaimukad sketšid toovad meieni armastatud Eesti näitlejad. Osades Taavi Teplenkov, Tiit Sukk, Marilyn Jurman, Tiina Tauraite, Margus Prangel ja Liina Vahtrik.

programme.title: Alo
programme.desc: Alo satub väljapressimise ohvriks, aga kui keegi teine ei saa sind aidata ja sa suudad nad üles leida, siis kutsu appi Bambergide sugulased Ruts ja Endel. Leelo tahab saada emaks, aga kust võtta isa? Viljot tabab šokk, sest Ahti on teinud kõva müüki, aga ülisoodsate hindadega. Viljo pea on pakul.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Õhtu!
