programme.desc: The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. Hosted by Eleni Giokos, the episodes bring stories about the fast growing industry, network communication, cross-border trade and increasing trading routes, air connectivity, logistics infrastructure, small businesses and more.

programme.title: The Lead with Jake Tapper
programme.desc: News, politics and current affairs programme hosted by the award-winning, American journalist and author, Jake Tapper. Jake Tapper is the chief Washington correspondent for CNN and he will share his knowledge and insight into politics as well as covering a variety of other topics. This programme discusses a range of stories from topical events including national news, economics/finance, sports, health, technology and world affairs. The Lead with Jake Tapper has won a number of awards and accolades including three National Headliner Awards. Outside his work on television, Tapper has written for The New Yorker, The Washington Post and the Los Angeles Times as well as publishing his first novel, a political thriller.

programme.title: World Sport
programme.desc: One of the CNN's longest running programmes that allows viewers to find out all the global sports news, see all the important events and most interesting parts, and enjoy the interviews with sports pundits and various sports stars.

programme.title: The Brief with Jim Sciutto
programme.desc: The best of CNN's reporting from correspondents across the world, to guide global audiences through the fast-paced news cycle with insight, analysis and hard-hitting interviews.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Jalgpall: Hispaania LaLiga. Girona vs Mallorca
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Maria ei saa enam Illimari ja tema perega ühendust ja kardab, et nad plaanivad midagi vastikut. Kristina lepib viimaks Lauraga, aga tegutseb salaja tema selja taga edasi. programme.desc: Statistika ütleb, et Eesti autostumine oli juba 1984. aastal 102, mis ületas Liidu keskmise kaks ja pool korda. Garaažipõud aina süvaneb. Filmis uuritaksegi garaažiehitusega seotud probleeme eeskätt Tartus. Räägivad Tartu Täitevkomitee osakonnajuhataja Rein Kams, jurist Silvi Lill, Informatsiooni Instituudi professor Rein Metsnik, vabariikliku ehituskomitee osakonnajuhataja Andres Leemets, Tartu linna peaarhitekt Raal Kivi, Tartu Ehitusteenindusvalitsuse juhataja Seesmaa, Tartu Ehitustrusti juhataja Jüri Alakivi, ühe Tallinna garaažikoopeatiivi esimees Härm Ruuse.

programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Miami CSI meeskonda juhib pommiekspert Horatio Caine. Temaga koos teostavad uurimisi ballistik ja relvaekspert Calleigh Duquesne ja raamatukoi Tim Speedle, kes tunneb Miami tänavaid nagu oma taskuid. Lisaks aitavad neid DNA spetsialist Alexx Woods ja sukelduja Eric Delko. See viisik toob alati tõe kuritegude kohta päevavalgele.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

programme.title: Valusad võmmid
programme.desc: Inglismaa 2007 märulikomöödia Lavastaja: Edgar Wright Osades: Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Jim Broadbent, Paddy Considine, Timothy Dalton Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) on Londoni edukaim politseinik, kelle tulemused on kolleegide omadest ligi 400% paremad. Ta on lausa nii suurepärane, et kõik teised tunduvad tema kõrval kahvatud. Seetõttu otsustatakse mees saata väikelinna Sandfordi, kus ta täht ei lööks niivõrd särama. Algul näiline tagasilöök saab aga väärt kulminatsiooni, kui Sandfordis hakkab juhtuma rida kummalisi ja veriseid juhtumeid. Uinuval väikelinnal on aeg saada tubli annus suurlinna õiglust. Pikkus: 2 tundi 1 minutit

programme.title: Teismeline täiskasvanu
programme.desc: Varsti pärast lahutust naaseb kirjanik oma koju Minnesotas, et taaselustada suhe oma endise poiss-sõbraga, kes on õnnelikus abielus pereisa.

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Seal, kus süda
programme.desc: 17-aastane rase Novalee Nation põgeneb oma armsamaga kodust. Unistav noormees jätab ta Oklahoma osariigis Sequoyah kaubanduskeskuses maha ja tüdruk peab enda eluga ise hakkama saama.

programme.title: Charlotte koob võrku
programme.desc: Siga Wilbur kardab hooaja lõppu, sest teab, et ta lõpetab lõunalaual. Koos ämblik Charlottega sepitseb ta salaplaani selle musta stsenaariumi ärahoidmiseks.

programme.title: Komandör Taylor
programme.desc: USA 2008 komöödia Lavastaja: Steven Brill Osades: Owen Wilson, Alex Frost, Casey Boersma, Steve Brill Juba esimesel koolipäeval satuvad kolm innukat uustulnukat, tüse Ryan, ebainimlikult kõhn Wade ja nende tagasihoidlik kannupoiss Emmit, kooli suurima psühhoterroristi Filkinsi (David Dorfman) märklauaks. Selleks, et nende senise elu parimast aastast ei saaks elavat põrgut, otsustavad poised palgata endale… ihukaitsja. Võimalike kandidaatide seast jääb sõelale Komandör Taylor (Owen Wilson), kes pole küll parim, kuid on see-eest odavaim. Ta on terasest lihastega, vilunud salaoperatsioone läbi viima ning oskab kõikvõimalikke võitluskunste. Tegelikult on ta lihtsalt suur jutumees ning varsti on poistel selge, et hoopis nemad peavad aitama Tayloril meheks saada…

programme.title: Mr. Beani puhkus
programme.desc: Inglismaa 2007 komöödia Lavastaja: Steve Bendelack Osades: Rowan Atkinson, Willem Dafoe, Jean Rochefort Mr Beani (Rowan Atkinson) otsustab enda puhkuse veeta Lõuna-Prantsusmaal, Rivieraras. Mr Beani puhkusest saab aga kaos, kui ta kohtub rongis lavastaja Emili ning tema 8 aaastase poja Stefaniga. Tutvus kulmineerub sellega, et kogu seltskond hakkab tegema Mr.Beani reisist videopäevikut Cannes'i filmifestivali jaoks. Pikkus: 1 tund 30 minutit

programme.title: Täitsa metsas!
programme.desc: Punamütsike, hunt, vanaema ja jahimees räägivad politseile nende kohtumise eellugu.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Taani dogi nimega Marmaduke toob uude kodusse kolinud pererahva ellu rõõmu ja kaost, millega nood on küll juba harjunud. Nüüd tuleb temaga harjuda ka naabritel.

programme.title: Unetu Seattle'is
programme.desc: Hiljuti leseks jäänud arhitekt Sam Baldwin kolib koos kaheksa-aastase poja Jonah'ga Seattle'isse. Aasta hiljem, jõululaupäeval, helistab Jonah raadio jutusaatesse ja veenab isa otse-eetris rääkima oma igatsusest lahkunud abikaasa järele. Tuhanded naised üle riigi kuulevad seda ja loost puudutatuna, kirjutavad Samile. Kirjutab ka ajalehereporter Annie Reed, kes pakub Samile välja kohtumise sõbrapäeval Empire State Buildingu katusel. R: Nora Ephron. O: Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Ross Malinger, Bill Pullman. Romantiline komöödia. Kahe Oscari nominent.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: USA 2011 komöödia Lavastaja: Greg Mottola Osades: Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Seth Rogen, Jason Bateman, Sigourney Weaver, Bill Hader Kaks ulmefänni külastavad Ameerika UFO-piirkonda. Nad kohtuvad seal juhuslikult tulnukaga, kellega koos algab hullumeelne teekond, mis muudab nende maailma igaveseks. Tulnukas nimega Paul on viimased 60 aastat veetnud ülisalajases sõjaväebaasis. Kui ta saab aru, et ta on sattunud vangistusse, otsustab nutikas kosmoserändur põgeneda ning hüpata esimesele linnast välja suunduvale autole. Selleks osutub maalaste Graeme Willy ja Clive Gollingsi matkaauto. Graeme ja Clive mõtlevad välja kohmaka plaani, kuidas Paul tagasi oma emalaeva toimetada, kuid neid hakkavad taga ajama föderaalagendid ning kogemata röövitud neiu fanaatiline isa.

programme.title: Amy tagaajamine
programme.desc: Holden ja Banky on koomiksikunstnikud, kellel läheb hästi, kuni nad kohtuvad Alyssaga. Holden armub neiusse, kuid tema lootused purunevad, kui selgub, et too on lesbi.

programme.title: Sue ja Mike
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia eduka ärinaise ja lihtsa motellitöötaja ootamatust armuloost. Jäine kaunitar Sue (Jennifer Aniston) ja romantiline unistaja Mike ei anna kaugeltki ideaalpaari mõõtu välja. Sellest hoolimata otsustab Mike naise südame vallutada, ehkki esialgu ei suuda ta ühtki toimivat võrgutusnippi leida... Film ei sobi alaealistele.
Endiste kurjategijate jõuk röövib Elvis Presley kokkutuleku ajal kasiinot.

programme.title: Kidz Megamix

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Nüüd on ta juba kaks aastat harjutanud parkuurimist Soufianiga, Brüsseli parima jäljekütiga. Ta teeb seda salaja, sest tema ema, innukas politseinik, ei kiidaks seda iial heaks. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
